[Skip to main content](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12651040-zoho-crm-integration#main-content) # Zoho CRM Integration Import and manage Hover spatial data directly in Zoho CRM July 6, 2026 Table of contents [Set up the integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12651040-zoho-crm-integration#h_1de355f34d)[Access or create a Hover job from a Zoho Deal](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12651040-zoho-crm-integration#h_781bf8f13b)[Viewing Hover’s spatial data within a Deal](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12651040-zoho-crm-integration#h_c09194179d)[Frequently asked questions](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12651040-zoho-crm-integration#h_9c4bb0f984) ### **Already managing your workflows within Zoho CRM?** Insyrge has built an integration with Hover that allows you to create Hover projects, and import the final measurements and all other project data directly within the Zoho CRM platform. In this article, we show how you to set up and leverage the integration to: - Automatically create Hover Capture Requests (i.e. invites to scan) from Zoho Deals - Create new Hover Jobs (i.e. projects) directly from a Zoho CRM Deal - Search for existing Hover jobs and import to a Deal - Improve accuracy, visibility, and efficiency when syncing the Hover project data back into the CRM - Automatically create three new modules inside Zoho CRM - Hover Users, Hover Jobs, and Hover Job Models) - Auto-sync all existing users and up to 1000 jobs from Hover to Zoho CRM - Manually sync photos, measurements, and documents into Deal attachments **Important notes before getting started:** - Zoho CRM supports both **single-structure and multi-structure projects** - Creating a User or Job in Zoho CRM does not automatically create it in the Hover platform - This integration does not fully sync historical data or attachments automatically - Certain actions (like linking jobs or retrieving deliverables) must be done through specific workflows outlined below ### **More of a visual learner? Check out their tutorial video.** # Set up the integration * * * **Note:** To set up this integration, you will need admin-level access to your Hover account, as well as admin-level access to your Zoho CRM account. - Click the Zoho Marketplace icon, and use the search bar to locate the **Hover Integration for Zoho CRM** or [use this link as a shortcut](https://marketplace.zoho.com/app/crm/hover-integration-for-zoho-crm). ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793717951/6238b792b58f87fc2dbcbe91f301/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+3_05_37%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=bda5122622b6dcd114f3fd55249b4e90d7c119a55935b713c095070126801641&req=dScuFc5%2FmohaWPMW1HO4zdklR1N3sBqvLUVoyVOQ4yr8NYBq4CGBQgEQ5%2BoL%0Ad45z%0A) - Click **Install** and follow the setup instructions - Once installed, three new modules will be added to your CRM automatically: - 1) Hover Users module - All your Hover users will auto-populate here - Includes Hover user information such as their name, email, and any assigned jobs - 2) Hover Jobs module - Up to 1,000 existing Hover projects will auto-populate here - Displays jobs (i.e. projects) imported from Hover - Includes job specific details, associated users, and linked CRM deals - 3) Hover Job Models - This module displays all models which are associated with a Hover job - Includes model details, artifacts, images, status, and linked job ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2524285583/93d8fa33f3ae343234eaedb8b9c5/Screenshot%2B2026-06-25%2Bat%2B4_33_27-E2-80-AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=22c529b045a0a417176ca3fd2ceb4da386d97e1dee8c1c2d19d1a5110084c628&req=diUlEst2mIRXWvMW1HO4zXYHzYuAcpM2L%2B4PaxTRpE00dbI6PjyYr0xuLZxH%0AOJ28kWUdNbHa41lY6Dg%3D%0A) # Access or create a Hover job from a Zoho Deal * * * - Open a Deal in Zoho CRM - Click the **Hover Portal** button on the top-right ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793723324/a94be14b6ffc284b7118da5db27f/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+3_51_17%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=9eaac27749c7ad214427f5650a93a19fe0bdd09bf876f61a7c5857293082ac42&req=dScuFc58noJdXfMW1HO4zbsXr23jnQGTsfV%2FHhrhnr2hxNxTJaL2JjMJQNK9%0AGy%2BTrecQS5N14bOHpuw%3D%0A) - The Hover Portal opens in a new page showing: - Existing Hover Jobs (i.e. projects) linked to this Deal, if applicable - An option to send an invite to scan (i.e. capture request) for a new Hover project linked to this deal, if applicable - An option to create a Hover project within the Deal - An option to search for an existing Hover Job by ID ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793728730/d87627a0c87bc7984d17ccabc7c6/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+3_55_38%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=df1abcc1fed814f3f4b241081db7a10b84f5794a00644af947a6debef4181bf6&req=dScuFc58lYZcWfMW1HO4zYIiY4MyfEiyf%2BQnYM2YXVAMxw59n9tWoVFaMeIe%0ASSSExslnnFGFjlCdLmg%3D%0A) **To create a new Hover project:** - Click **Create job** from the right side menu of the Hover portal - Fill in the required details: - User Information (assignee details) - Job Details (project specifics) ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793731347/4607698a8e570cfc88c3a5893873/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+3_57_12%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=db8769b14039424c689a9da9bc1a721512707647be6b63816375e1f91967e110&req=dScuFc59nIJbXvMW1HO4ze9dpQxm8X%2Fi9WMaHOYk%2B7GZbu7g8j%2FPgyY4a%2F2v%0Aq5KGL9P%2FJR0rfBAdS8M%3D%0A) - Click **Submit** - The new job will appear in your Hover account projects list and the assignee will receive an email notification with: - A direct link to download the Hover app - Instructions to take property photos through the Hover app ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793738594/d9a01d7bc1f59c12c04441df2f9c/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+4_00_14%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=de87ef8ef2bf7e1bf6f98ad16ec2d17babe96596a8055382d76f6cc311bcd2cb&req=dScuFc59lYRWXfMW1HO4zUrjsXTmPdXl2aKj3XBO9bxBRGTsB5%2FA52WcUyog%0A1a11uBt3i%2FbfKZKzVmg%3D%0A) | | | --- | | **Note:**
- Hover projects (i.e. jobs) created _outside_ of this flow **_can_** be linked later

- Creating a job from the Hover Jobs module will _not_ automatically create a job in Hover | # Viewing Hover’s spatial data within a Deal * * * After the assignee submits property photos and the Hover deliverables are ready, attachments do not automatically sync to Zoho CRM. To access Hover measurements and file types: - Open the Deal within Zoho CRM - Click the **Hover Portal** button on the top-right - Locate the job and click **Request Images** or **Request Measurements** ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2524323018/30d8c617bc6e48d676f55967948b/Screenshot+2026-06-25+at+4_31_43%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=4061750dc0a6b0dff34344188df9468b383e24b0ceaa2785bc97feb64597a9c0&req=diUlEsp8noFeUfMW1HO4zaVk5EUGtzFpKRlsRDvFMDIx1Mfiugm%2FshnTZ7%2BF%0A5xojxnTwP2UmHvdlJBs%3D%0A) Once requested, the images or measurements will appear in the Attachments section of the Deal. ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793744072/2a2b75953f85c3cde8b8d0322303/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+4_05_00%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=6ea51fac1259b201c3a53e519fca6f45911a558bc9b45169a3065529f688f5b6&req=dScuFc56mYFYW%2FMW1HO4zTZ7kKivAospVNLgT8wOI5phXAna87Su%2FQlClKgq%0AGUc0uk5z%2Fc%2FKpMQu1n0%3D%0A) # Frequently asked questions * * * _Click on the arrows to expand or collapse answers to the questions._ **Where in the CRM can I see all Hover Users?** Open the **Hover Users** module from the **top** of the page. ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1793749695/679f6d8974d607b31a2eb5329408/Screenshot+2025-10-23+at+4_09_34%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=168dc841c62d8decdf1a3ccc07c278dde50d45e1c7be48ca6d9d37441bb371ad&req=dScuFc56lIdWXPMW1HO4zSOPbLigBNsJKRLxJpOMBqBiCkMPkOfwbURbMrzI%0AmDC10kevIGPFu8pwpGY%3D%0A) **Can I link multiple Hover projects / jobs to a single Deal?** Yes, you can link multiple projects to one deal through the Hover Portal. **Where in the CRM do uploaded Hover photos/documents appear?** They are stored under the Attachments section of the related Deal **When I install the extension, will old projects from Hover automatically sync?** - Up to 1,000 existing Hover jobs and all users will sync into Zoho CRM after installation. However: - Attachments (images, measurements) do not automatically sync - Deliverables for the _older jobs cannot_ be requested - However, any new jobs created through a Zoho CRM-sent capture request _can_ have deliverables manually requested from within each Deal **Still have questions? Reach out to their support team.** If you encounter issues with either the installation of Insyrge's integration or syncing Hover’s measurements into the Zoho CRM, **we recommend reaching out directly to their support team** for the fastest resolution. They can be reached by email: [info@insyrge.com](mailto:info@insyrge.com) * * * Related Articles - [CompanyCam Integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/2599446-companycam-integration) - [JobNimbus Integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/2599470-jobnimbus-integration) - [AccuLynx Integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/10048438-acculynx-integration) - [Zuper Integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/12401478-zuper-integration) - [Zoho Flow Integration](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/13755172-zoho-flow-integration) Did this answer your question?
